info.description: Platform service API for Kneo Agent runs, specs, traces, checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop tasks.
info.title: Kneo Agent Platform API

get.description:
Generate a policy report for the spec the run was started with.

Returns the same shape as `POST /specs/policy-report` but pulls the
spec out of the existing run's metadata, so operators don't need to
carry the spec bundle locally to audit a deployed run.
